objective: Prove #P-hardness for pair failures whose higher layers interact with the gadget characters, under explicit character conditions on the edge (vertex pairings vanish on the private variety; non-forced layer-2 brackets are harmless), using zero-jump gadgets, a locality lemma, a Brunnian rank lemma and anchor isolation; state precisely what the conditions leave open.
status: Proved: interacting pair failures with a clean edge are #P-hard (Theorem 4; zero-jump gadgets, locality on the layer-2 variety, Brunnian rank lemma, subdivision), with a character-0 refinement (Theorem 5); 55 of 176 interacting census algebras decided; the open ones classified by failing conditions.
title: Interacting pair failures with a clean edge are #P-hard
